goal: Full functional correspondence in Code. No excluded archive subsystems.

status_meaning.equivalent: Equivalent for the described contract; independent implementation, not identical code or wire format.
status_meaning.partial: Some behavior exists, remaining gaps described explicitly.
status_meaning.unclassified: Inventoried but requires further behavioral decomposition.

dependency_audit.method: Static relative-import scan; does not infer build-time generated modules or private package contents.

tools.notes: Up to 3 concurrent implement/explore/review agents in private snapshot worktrees, durable output, progress, resume and explicit detach. Named durable teams, direct/broadcast mail and append-only worker protocol history with resume are implemented. Lead collects attached results and receives peer mail while waiting. Lead and worker protocol replay, rollback/compact-aware context and lead worktree switching are implemented. Import/fork of a selected JSON/JSONL branch and structured approval/shutdown are implemented. Full attribution, all attachments and archive protocol parity remain.
1-4 structured questions, single/multiple choice and free text; durable answers and same-worker continuation. Code UI can resume after interruption.

Foreground/background commands, project-relative cwd, persistent stdin for interactive processes, live output, timeout/stop, binary/text/mode file imports with diffs, CAS conflicts, durable pending results and rollback. PTY and resizing are implemented; missing automatic in-place foreground promotion, full shell snapshot/profile and archive-specific permission semantics.
Need agent-controlled concise output mode.
No compatible agent-facing settings tool.
The user can select Plan; the agent cannot change the mode itself.

Lead switches tools mid-turn into durable private Git worktrees with source history/current dirty files, separate cache IDs and worker scopes; original source/index/branch preserved. Ref selection and explicit editor/terminal binding are implemented; hook-created worktrees remain.
No structured submitted plan and acceptance transition.

Lead returns to source, keeps/resumes or explicitly discards its copy. Complete since-entry diff, ZIP and fixed generated branch publication using owner credentials; scoped rollback cannot overwrite source. Draft GitHub PR creation is implemented; archive hooks/tmux and merge lifecycle remain.
Exact fragment replacement with optimistic hashes, diff and rollback.
Text ranges and hashes; missing multimodal images/PDF extraction.
Atomic UTF-8 project-scoped writes and version checks.
Project-scoped pageable search; fnmatch behavior differs from ripgrep glob syntax.
Bounded regex/content/count/context; no full ripgrep flag compatibility.

completion_rule: No full parity claim while partial/missing/unclassified contracts remain. Each equivalent requires behavior tests; CI alone is not a parity certificate.
